subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Extraordinary students are **__controlled thinkers and creators__** who learn best when their training is dynamic, approachable and project-based.
solution:
The correct answer is **"independent thinkers and creators."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

 
• In the context of the sentence provided, **"controlled thinkers and creators" **might imply students who are directed or constrained in their learning and creative endeavors by external factors such as rigid curriculum, strict guidelines, or limited autonomy. (प्रदान किए गए वाक्य के संदर्भ में, "controlled thinkers and creators" का तात्पर्य ऐसे छात्रों से हो सकता है जो अपने सीखने और रचनात्मक प्रयासों में कठोर पाठ्यक्रम, सख्त दिशानिर्देश या सीमित स्वायत्तता जैसे बाहरी कारकों द्वारा निर्देशित या बाधित होते हैं)
 
• This interpretation suggests a lack of freedom or independence in their thinking and creative expression.
 
• **"Independent thinkers and creators"** refers to individuals who are capable of thinking and creating freely, without undue influence or constraint from external factors. (ऐसे व्यक्ति जो बाहरी कारकों के अनुचित प्रभाव या बाधा के बिना, स्वतंत्र रूप से सोचने और निर्माण करने में सक्षम हैं)
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
